findings_and_questions.first_contract: ClosureMeshes retains separate HashMaps for doors, glass and shutters keyed by the exact bits of admitted dimensions and stores mesh handles or material-part handles. A cache miss inserts an entry and the full inspected cache body has no eviction. The inspected clear_demo_scene/clear_scene_entities source replaces other caches and despawns scene leaves but does not clear or replace ClosureMeshes. If their called reset functions and other uninspected mechanisms do not replace the resource, distinct dimension tuples can accumulate across those cleanup calls.
findings_and_questions.condition: A long-lived application must load many distinct dimensions while keeping the resource; another uninspected teardown or resource replacement may bound lifetime. Native asset-reference strength, memory usage and actual lifecycle frequency were not established, so this is not a measured leak.
findings_and_questions.future_direction: Determine app/scene ownership and expected reuse, measure only in a later authorized validation stage, and decide whether explicit resource lifetime or bounded retention is required while retaining intended same-size instancing.

findings_and_questions.first_contract: CityGate builds an opening ID by OR-ing a public property ID with a fixed mask and recognizes an opening by testing the same mask. The door presentation observer skips the building-specific closure visibility marker for any opening satisfying the predicate. SceneDoor accepts a u64 opening ID at serde admission; no reserved-bit check is shown there. An ordinary opening with those mask bits would take the gate branch.
findings_and_questions.condition: The actual property/opening ID producers and their reserved-bit guarantees were not traced; no claim that ordinary generated IDs collide with the tag or that a live door is wrongly presented. SceneDoor is an immutable ECS component and its actual server producer supplies its typed opening at spawn.
findings_and_questions.future_direction: Establish authoritative namespace and injectivity/reserved-bit policy for CityPropertyId and OpeningAssemblyId, including externally admitted values, before choosing a representation or validation boundary. Preserve intentional gate visibility behavior.
